title: Why it sucks being a Barcelona fan
tagLine: WHO STILL TALKS ABOUT THE REMONTADA

scenes.text: Why it sucks being a... Barcelona fan!
It starts when you're seven. You win the treble. Messi. Neymar. Suárez. You think this is normal.
Age ten. Three-nil in Rome. Age eleven. Four-nil at Anfield. A corner taken quickly. Age twelve. Eight-two against Bayern. You stop checking the score.
Age thirteen. Messi leaves. Not because he wants to. Because you can't afford him.
Age fourteen. The club sells its future TV money... to buy players now. Your dad calls it "economic levers". You call it a credit card.
Age fifteen. Your stadium is being rebuilt. So you play on a mountain. Then you lose to Antwerp. Yes. Antwerp.
Age seventeen. The best player in the world is seventeen. Same age as you. Your mum asks what you've done with your life.
That's the thing about being a Barça fan. You can't always afford your players... but you can always afford drama.
But every few years, a kid from your academy saves everything. More than a club.
Tag a Barça fan who still talks about the Remontada. And which club is next? Drop it in the comments!
